component.name: Parquet Viewer
component.summary: Fast, read-only viewer for Parquet files

description.p: Parquet Viewer opens Parquet files of any size in an instant and lets you scroll, filter and sort them without importing anything. It reads only the rows you are looking at, so a file with 100 million rows feels as quick as one with a hundred. Everything runs locally on your machine, and files are never modified.

ul.li: Filter and sort with a SQL WHERE and ORDER BY clause, and pick or compute columns
See file metadata, the full schema and column profiles
Copy cells and rows, and export the current view as Parquet or CSV

screenshot.caption: A Parquet file with its schema, column statistics and data grid
